hooks.command:
out=$(git ls-files -- .env ".claude/settings.local.json" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && printf "%s (should be gitignored); " "$f"; done); if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"⚠️ git hygiene: %s\"}}
" "$out"; fi
